source: Approved idle offline bare checkpoint; 1 CPU, 256 MiB RAM, 1 GiB storage and overlay
storage: Encrypted PostgreSQL shared adapter, separate capture/confirm/restore/release BEAM processes
limitations: Host asserted idle state and quiescence; HTTP does not attest these
No container image dependency retention, network restore, arbitrary application resume or live branches
No power-loss durability or hard host quota qualification
validation_notes: The first rerun exposed an empty JSON start-body regression. It was corrected, the fake peer now enforces JSON, and the full acceptance scenario passed again.
A rejected-start machine was explicitly resolved after verifying rejection before the worker handler, deleted and confirmed absent.

existing_checkpoint_runtime_tests.transport: Private UNIX socket proxy to the owned 1.19.0 HTTP worker
scenarios: independent restores with file staging and collection
